newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Ipmuda shares suspended - KLSE.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Ipmuda shares suspended - KLSE.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian building materials maker Ipmuda Bhd were suspended from trading on Tuesday afternoon, said the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange.
A company official at Ipmuda said the suspension had been requested by the company pending an announcement.
An industry source said that the suspension could have been requested due to property developer IGB Corp Bhd looking to sell a 20 percent stake in the company.
IGB officials were not available for comment.
IGB currently owns around 44 percent of Ipmuda, a company that supplies tiles for the residential contruction industry.
Ipmuda was last traded at 6.20 ringgit, up 40 cents on Monday's close. At 0754 GMT, IGB was trading up six cents at 3.06 ringgit.
